# CUNY Pressbooks Network

> > Open publishing platform enabling CUNY faculty and students to create, customize, and distribute open educational resources and course materials.

CUNY Pressbooks Network is the City University of New York's dedicated platform for open publishing, built on Pressbooks technology. It provides free tools for creating and sharing open textbooks, course materials, and educational resources with support for multiple export formats including EPUB and PDF.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Open Publishing
- Book Publishing

## Getting Started

- [CUNY Pressbooks Network Homepage](https://pressbooks.cuny.edu): Main entry point for CUNY Pressbooks Network, open publishing platform for course materials and OER.
- [CUNY Pressbooks Guide](https://pressbooks.cuny.edu/cunypressbooksguide): Comprehensive tutorial guide for publishing books with CUNY Pressbooks and download formats.
- [About CUNY Pressbooks Network](https://pressbooks.cuny.edu/about): Information about CUNY Pressbooks Network, its mission, and digital publishing capabilities.

## Browse & Discover

- [Open Textbook Catalog](https://pressbooks.cuny.edu/catalog): Searchable catalog of open educational resources and textbooks published via CUNY Pressbooks.
